CLASS.implementation_rule: Implement the frozen RLL perturbation closure in CLASS conventions directly from the closure contract.
must_not_use: CAMB-generated perturbation outputs as implementation inputs
the internal RK4 growth kernel as a substitute for the Boltzmann hierarchy
CLASS.required_receipt: engine version/commit, build/runtime, parameter vector, precision settings, outputs and checksums

CAMB.implementation_rule: Implement the same frozen RLL perturbation closure independently in CAMB conventions directly from the closure contract.
must_not_use: CLASS-generated perturbation outputs as implementation inputs
the internal RK4 growth kernel as a substitute for the Boltzmann hierarchy
CAMB.required_receipt: engine version/commit, build/runtime, parameter vector, precision settings, outputs and checksums

required_cross_engine_observables: CMB TT/TE/EE Cl where the closure permits a well-posed calculation
precision_and_convergence_protocol: Predeclare identical cosmological/RLL vectors and convention mapping.
Run at least a baseline precision and a stricter precision configuration for each engine.
Demonstrate numerical convergence within each engine before cross-engine comparison.
Predeclare cross-engine tolerance per observable before interpreting the result.
Record lmax/kmax/grid/cutoff settings so cutoff artifacts cannot masquerade as physics.
required_limiting_cases: declared zero-RLL or background limiting case
standard LCDM engine baseline already covered by the existing CLASS/CAMB baseline authority
any additional limit explicitly implied by the final RLL closure contract
falsifiers: implementation begins while any C01-C08 closure slot remains an unassigned physical assumption
CLASS and CAMB use inequivalent physical closures or initial conditions
one engine fails its own precision-convergence test
cross-engine difference exceeds a predeclared tolerance
observable depends materially on arbitrary numerical regularization
RLL CMB or P(k) output is produced by the existing matter-growth approximation and labeled full Boltzmann
close_when: the closure dependency is versioned and passes its required tests
independent CLASS and CAMB RLL implementations execute
each engine demonstrates internal numerical convergence
cross-engine comparisons for required observables pass predeclared tolerances or disagreements are preserved as negative evidence
all configs, outputs, hashes and convention mappings are persisted
claim_boundary: Independent solver agreement is implementation verification. Observational validation requires separate likelihood/data evidence and remains subject to claim_allowed=false until its own gates close.
